entry.title: PotentialKits 1.1.0
entry.summary: **PotentialKits 1.1.0** Fixes for SAVE and LOCK, and simpler pages. - **Fixed: SAVE, then a USER KITS slot, saved nothing.** One touch on a button reaches the plugin as two quick flips, and SAVE switched itself straight back off. It now stays lit ("NOW TAP A SLOT") until you tap a slot, empty or full. - **Fixed: LOCK unlocked straight away** (the * showed for a moment). - **Four pages instead of five:** KIT, STYLES, SAVE, SETUP (plus MANUAL). - **KIT:** NEW KIT and ROLL at the top; for the selec

entry.title: PotentialKits 1.0.0
entry.summary: **PotentialKits 1.0.0** A drum kit from your own samples, one tap at a time. The first release of PotentialKits, a PotentialSuite fork of sd88me's [Lucky Dip](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-luckydip). - **KIT STYLES:** one tap for a whole kit in a style: CLASSIC, BOOM BAP, LO-FI, TRAP, HOUSE, DUSTY JAZZ, PERCUSSION, ELECTRO or WEIRD. - **ROLL** with MILD, MEDIUM or WILD. - **PITCH, DECAY and CHOKE** on every pad, kept in the exported kit: changed pads are saved as you hear them, choke groups
